_comment: Per-route metadata for SEO. Read by the client (src/lib/seo.ts) and by scripts/prerender-meta.mjs, which bakes it into a static HTML file per route so non-JS crawlers and social scrapers get real titles, descriptions and Open Graph tags. Keep titles under ~60 chars and descriptions 120-160.
